ठ: 1. ठ the aspirate of the preceding consonant.
2. ठ m. a loud noise (ठठं ठठं ठं ठठठं ठठं ठः, an imitative sound as of a golden pitcher rolling down steps, Mahān. 2 iii, 5), L.
a place frequented by all, L.
ठकार: ठ—कार m. the letter ठ्, Pāṇ. viii, 4, 41; Kāś.
ठंसरी: ठंसरी f. N. of a stringed instrument.
ठक्क: ठक्क m. a merchant (= टक्क), Inscr. (1st century A.D.)
ठक्कन: ठक्कन m. N. of a prince, Rājat. vi, 230ff. and 236(vv.ll. ड्कक्क्°, थक्क्°).
ठक्कुर: ठक्कुर m. a deity, object of reverence, man of rank, chief (the modern ‘Thākūr, Tagore’ added to names), , vii f.; Dhūrtas. i, 19/20
ठिण्ठा: ठिण्ठा f. a gaming-house, Kathās.; xcii, 15 and 21 (टिण्°), cxxiv, 211
N. of a woman, Rājat. vii, 103.
ठिण्ठाकराल: ठिण्ठा—कराल m. N. of a gaming-house keeper, Kathās. cxxi, 71f.
ठेत्कृत: ठेत्-कृत n. the roaring (of a bull), Alaṃkārat.
ठेपक: ठेपक or ठेवक, m. N. of a chief, Inscr.
ठेवक: ठेपक or ठेवक, m. N. of a chief, Inscr.
ठोण्ठपद्धति: ठोण्ठ-पद्धति f. N. of wk., Śūdradh.
